verse.text: My children, listen when your father corrects you. Pay attention and learn good judgment, for I am giving you good guidance. Don't turn away from my instructions.

video.title: My Father's Approval | 1 John 3:1 | Our Daily Bread Video Devotional

reflection: Every dad is writing instructions his kids will carry for the rest of their lives, whether he means to or not. The good news in Proverbs 4 is that you don't have to be perfect to pass on wisdom—just present, honest, and willing to keep pointing your kids toward what's true. A few minutes of real correction and encouragement today will outlast almost anything else you give them.
